contextTips.label: Context help
contextTips.jql: JQL filters issues by field, operator, and value. Examples: status = "In Progress", assignee = currentUser(), type IN (bug, task). Use ORDER BY created DESC to sort.
contextTips.wip: WIP (Work In Progress) limit caps how many cards a column may hold. When count reaches the limit, the column highlights in red — finish or move work before adding more.
contextTips.allure: POST Allure JSON to the webhook after CI runs. Match test cases via @allure.id("PROJ-TC-1") or AS_ID label so Hub links results to TMS cases automatically.
